description: Potential Secret in Launch Template User Data
rationale: User data is stored with the launch template and handed unencrypted to every instance created from it, where it is served by the metadata service to anything able to reach it from the instance. A secret written there is therefore copied to each new instance for as long as the template is used, is readable by anyone who can describe the template, and cannot be rotated without publishing a new version. Credentials and keys belong in Secrets Manager or Parameter Store, fetched at boot with the permissions of the instance profile.
remediation: Remove the secrets from the user data of the launch template version, rotate whatever was exposed, and retrieve the values at boot from Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store instead
